facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: This trace should not be trusted as following the same sheet, with a median distance of 8.5 voxels and only 31.7 percent within 5 voxels and 13.2 percent within 2 voxels, and it is not on the clicked layer. It is weakest around the click shown as a yellow dot, where the red line visibly jumps between layers in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19. The fix improved agreement from 14.5 percent within 5 voxels and a median distance of 18.9 voxels, but coverage remains low across 19 of 20 slices. A person should check the layers around the yellow dot against the red line at the voxel size of 7.91 micrometres and confirm which sheet was actually clicked.
